messages.text: Looked up for Sarah: Magic Miner 40T, $799, Batch 5 ships Nov 14, 2026 — best value per TH we sell; power runs roughly $20–30 a month at under 12¢.
Looked up for Sarah: 40T at 10¢: ~57,500 sats/month (~$48) vs $47 power — about break-even; block odds 0.22% a year, jackpot ~$263k.
Looked up for Sarah: Cart ready, one Magic Miner 40T, $799, Batch 6 — link sent to their screen; ships Nov 14, 2026.

At under twelve cents, the Magic Miner 40T is our best value per terahash, at seven ninety-nine. It takes a shot at a full 3.125 Bitcoin block roughly every ten minutes, and it stacks sats to your own wallet the whole time.

At home power the sats usually come to less than the electricity — that's not why people buy it. People buy the Magic Miner 40T for a shot at a full three-point-one-two-five Bitcoin block every ten minutes, for years, while it stacks sats straight to their own wallet.

At ten cents a kilowatt-hour, it's about break-even right now: roughly forty-eight dollars of sats a month against forty-seven dollars of power. That moves with Bitcoin's price and difficulty, so I can't promise it pays itself back. The real draw is the chance of mining a whole block, worth about two hundred sixty thousand dollars, with odds of about a fifth of a percent each year. It's the Magic Miner 40T at seven ninety-nine, shipping in Batch 5 on November 14th, and the Add to cart button is right there on the page. (The call ended. 3 shopper turn(s). Reply NOTHING.)
